gen1-clean-root-roms.description: User-supplied US-English Red, Blue and Yellow dumps at the repository root, with the filenames and SHA1s pinned by tests/gen1_release_inputs.json and data/pret_sources.lock.json.
gen1-clean-root-roms.provisioning: Provision the legal dump inputs in the local release checkout; do not upload ROMs to public CI.

gen1-clean-staged-roms.description: User-supplied clean dumps staged as patch/build/gen1_red.gb, gen1_blue.gb and gen1_yellow.gbc. Each exact test reads its named title(s).
gen1-clean-staged-roms.provisioning: Provision the local release inputs with the pinned clean dumps; keep full ROM bytes outside Git and public artifacts.

gen1-pinned-sources.description: Pinned .cache/pret/pokered, pokeyellow and alchav_pokered source checkouts. Tests independently inspect constants, layouts, instructions or reference graphs.
gen1-pinned-sources.provisioning: Use tools/build_pret_syms.py with data/pret_sources.lock.json in the local evidence checkout. Public CI does not implicitly download or search ancestor source caches.

gen1-canonical-build-provenance.description: Full canonical source/build/symbol/tool hash chain: legal root ROMs, .cache/pret builds, .cache/pret-build raw symbols, and pinned tool binaries recorded in data/pret_build_provenance.json.
gen1-canonical-build-provenance.provisioning: Run python tools/build_pret_syms.py --canonical --rom-dir <legal-dump-directory>, then python tools/verify_canonical_sources.py in the local release checkout.

gen1-built-red-companion.description: The full local patch/gen1/build/slink_red.gb build for byte-for-byte comparison with the structural injector.
gen1-built-red-companion.provisioning: Build with python patch/gen1/tools/build.py using the pinned local dump and RGBDS prerequisites.

upr-zx-java.description: UPR ZX 4.6.1 PokeRandoZX.jar plus Java; these component tests execute the real randomizer and inspect its outputs.
upr-zx-java.provisioning: Provision the pinned local JAR via .cache/upr or SLINK_UPR_JAR and Java on PATH; verify inputs using the local release manifest. These legacy component tests do not approve UPR publication.

gen2-pinned-sources.description: .cache/pret/pokecrystal and pokegold source checkouts for independent item-pocket checks.
gen2-pinned-sources.provisioning: Provision the local source checkouts with tools/build_pret_syms.py; retain the separate Gen 2 qualification scope.

installed-crystal-apworld.description: Installed C:/ProgramData/Archipelago/custom_worlds/pokemon_crystal.apworld, read directly for its declared RAM-address table.
installed-crystal-apworld.provisioning: Run the exact source-comparison tests on the local Archipelago installation. They do not qualify AP Crystal runtime behavior.

browser-node-playwright.description: Node.js, Playwright and a real Chrome/Chromium executable for local file-selection/apply/download browser E2E.
browser-node-playwright.provisioning: Set SLINK_NODE or put node on PATH; install Playwright in node_modules or NODE_PATH; use its browser or set SLINK_CHROMIUM. Tests record actual browser/runtime versions and executable SHA256. Profiles/downloads remain in test staging.

gen1-canonical-companion-patches.description: Current checked R/B panel+trade and Yellow trade-only UPS files under patch/gen1/build/companion_<variant>.
gen1-canonical-companion-patches.provisioning: Run tools/build_gen1_companion.py and tools/generate_gen1_patcher_targets.py with the pinned legal R/B/Y inputs and build prerequisites. Do not distribute full ROMs.
